name: Projected Strongly Shattered Dimension of Singletons
proof: For $n=1$, every projection has one trace, so it contains no positive-dimensional cube. For $n\ge2$, projection onto a single coordinate has both traces and contains a one-cube. No projection shatters a pair, since two positive coordinates never occur together; a contained cube would shatter its coordinate set. Thus the maximum contained-cube dimension over projections is one.
